title: Local Legendzz: The Devil's Crack House ft. The Paranormal Files pt.1
excerpt: Collin Browen appeared on the program Local Legendzz to discuss his paranormal investigation of a San Angelo home nicknamed "The Crack House From Hell."
content:
Shawn Torres

Sat, September 12, 2026 at 3:00 PM UTC

1 min read

SAN ANGELO, Texas (Concho Valley Homepage) — Co-host Shawn and Zach interview Collin Browen, the host of The Paranormal File YouTube channel. They interview him about his time investigating a house here in San Angelo, Texas, which he named "The Crack House From Hell".

On episode 4 of Local Legendzz Browen opens up about his experience doing a paranormal investigation here in San Angelo. His video titled "The Crack House From HELL: The Most DISTURBING Video We've EVER Filmed (SCARY Paranormal Activity)" has amassed over 880k views on his channel. The channel itself has gained around 1.5 million followers since he started it over 11 years ago.
